sections.heading: What is trending: “iphone 18”
paragraphs: “iphone 18” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for TR (snapshot taken 2026-09-02T18:43:07+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Investing.com Türkiye, Teknolojioku, Webtekno. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Apple’ın katlanabilir iPhone’u 14 milyar dolarlık fırsat mı?” — Investing.com Türkiye
“iPhone 18 Pro'nun Tahmini Türkiye Fiyatı Belli Oldu” — Webtekno
“iPhone 18 Pro sızdı: İşte teknoloji dünyasını sallayacak 3 büyük yenilik!” — Teknolojioku

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-02T18:43:07+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-02T18:43:25+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
